title: UNI gate row
description: One row of the append-only gate ledger at evidence/gates.ndjson. Every gate the project claims to have passed, partially passed, failed, withheld, or has open MUST be represented here, keyed to a real receipt on disk.

name.description: Short unique identifier. Kebab-case. Examples: motor-red, curiosity-phase1-novelty, forage-runway-closed, forage-pureworld-graduation, g-pa, verdict-live-real-driver, metabolism-activation.

pass_condition.description: Verbatim, machine-checkable PASS statement. Quote the receipt or pre-registration verbatim; do not paraphrase.

falsifies_condition.description: Verbatim, machine-checkable FALSIFIES statement. The gate FAILS if this is observed.

receipt_path.description: Repo-relative path to the receipt establishing the current verdict. MUST exist. CI test at test/gate_registry_integrity_test.exs enforces this.

pre_registration_path.description: Repo-relative path to the docs/receipts/red_preregistration_*.md that named the RED before the run. Empty for corroborated infra gates (G-PA) or gates preregistered inside their main doc (Motor RED).

verdict.description: Honest verdict vocabulary. Never percent-scored. WITHHELD = a claim was withdrawn; PENDING = registered but not run.

evidence_class.description: Per production/docs/GAPS_REGISTER.md: A = independently reproduced, B = observed-with-artifact, C = command-output, Sec = security-relevant-unproven, pending = not-yet-established.

last_updated.description: ISO date of the verdict-establishing receipt.

supersedes.description: Names of prior rows this row supersedes (kept for the audit trail; do not delete supersede-target rows).

notes.description: One-line honest context (why PARTIAL, what's the fix-forward, what's the confounder).
